resolvedAttempts.name: focused-1793
resolvedAttempts.reason: Initial fixtures incorrectly treated Dark GUY as colorless, counted a multicolor Charger entering tapped as paid mana, and used an unattached aura on a face-down vanilla shield. Corrected to official Dark stats, distinguish three paid mana from the tapped Charger, and actually attach Zaha onto a GR creature protecting an actual face-up Shield Go card. Dark GUY entry spec was corrected from a type-qualified filter without a card type to the native all-card color search, then upgraded to native Look with reveal of the chosen card and full controller-only deck inspection. All final checks use the corrected full ability and retain earlier failed logs.
